evals.prompt: Use solver-skill-card to write a card for the Choco (Java) solver in the supplied isolated checkout. Verify it in the solver's evaluation image. Do not push.
prerequisites: A clean checkout on a branch the agent may create
evals.expected_output: One card.md following the template (title, knapsack example, API rows, modelling section, docs URL), with a log of the runs that verified it; or an explicit blocker with evidence.
assertions: The example runs in the solver's image and prints the optimum 22
Every form named in the API and modelling sections ran in a scratch program
The card is under 200 lines and 5000 characters
The card names no harness glue (entrypoint, instance reading, output registration)
The modelling section has a search bullet only if the model controls search
